items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: the guys that I talked the most to are Kid Punch and Kid Thomas and Manuel Mineta and Johnny Wiggs

ctx.x: has an idea, would it help him to go take lessons from his idea?

Yeah, sure. I don't see why not. That's the idea I had. And a lot of times the lessons wouldn't be involved with playing the instrument at all. Just talking. Talking to them. Understanding maybe the kind of life they led. This all goes into New Orleans music. Who did you go and talk to? Well, the guys that I talked the most to are Kid Punch and Kid Thomas and Manuel Mineta and Johnny Wiggs. I think those are the four guys I spent the most amount of time with. Of the trumpet men, you know. Although Mineta teaches…
